title: Breakdown of Autoregressive Multi-Step Reasoning Under Concentrated vs. Diffuse Attention Head Dropout
abstract: arXiv:2611.14209v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: During extended wakefulness, mammalian neocortical networks experience localized periods of transient neuronal silence termed off-states. Here, we examine how analogous spatiotemporally concentrated disruptions affect sequential reasoning in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs). Evaluating 250 paired derivations on the GSM8K benchmark across two 8B models (Qwen3-8B and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct), we contrast clustered bursts of attention head masking against budget-matched diffuse i.i.d. dropout. Concentrated bursts induce substantial reasoning degradation: at onset parameter $\mathcal{B}=0.10$ (scheduling $\sim 5.7\%$ of vulnerable head-token volume), Qwen3-8B accuracy drops from $91.2\%$ under diffuse noise to $78.8\%$ under burst dropout ($\Delta = -12.4$ percentage points [pp], exact McNemar $p = 5.5 \times 10^{-6}$), while LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct drops from $84.0\%$ to $76.8\%$ ($\Delta = -7.2$ pp, $p = 0.0198$). translated_title: 集中式与分散式注意力头失活下自回归多步推理的崩溃
translated_abstract: 在持续清醒期间，哺乳动物的新皮层网络会经历局部、短暂的神经元沉默期，被称为“关闭状态”（off-states）。本文研究了类似的时空集中式扰动如何影响自回归大语言模型（LLM）的序列推理能力。我们在GSM8K基准上对两个8B模型（Qwen3-8B与LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct）进行了250组配对推导评估，将聚簇爆发的注意力头掩码与预算匹配的分散式独立同分布失活进行对比。结果表明，集中式爆发会导致显著的推理性能退化：在起始参数 $\mathcal{B}=0.10$（调度约5.7%的易感头-词元容量）下，Qwen3-8B的准确率从分散噪声条件下的91.2%降至爆发式失活条件下的78.8%（Δ = −12.4个百分点，精确McNemar检验 p = 5.5×10⁻⁶），而LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct则从84.0%降至76.8%（Δ = −7.2个百分点，p = 0.0198）。相反，分散式……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 受哺乳动物大脑“关闭状态”启发，该研究发现对大语言模型注意力头施加集中式爆发失活，比同等规模的分散式失活会造成严重得多的多步数学推理性能下降。
en_tdlr: Inspired by cortical "off-states," this paper demonstrates that concentrated bursts of attention head dropout degrade multi-step mathematical reasoning in LLMs far more severely than budget-matched diffuse dropout.
